verdict.rationale: Bland is documented as a hosted enterprise voice AI platform (call dispatch, pathways, SIP, MCP, CLI) with no mention of an on-prem/self-hosted deployment option; 'enterprise' release controls (docs-14, docs-29, docs-31) only govern version adoption timing on Bland's own infrastructure, not customer self-hosting. A community post explicitly looks for an open-source self-hostable alternative because Bland itself doesn't offer this.
